command.abilityeffects.help.intro: §7Welcome! This mod grants you unique abilities using special items. Once used, they attach to you permanently until dropped or lost.
command.abilityeffects.help.keybind1: §b• [%s Key] §7- Triggers the active special effect of your §aFirst Active Ability§7.
command.abilityeffects.help.keybind2: §b• [%s Key] §7- Triggers the active special effect of your §aSecond Active Ability§7 (e.g., opens Player Tracker GUI).
command.abilityeffects.help.pvp_drop: §b• PvP Death Penalty §7- If killed by another player, you will §crandomly lose one active ability§7 as an item drop!
command.abilityeffects.help.void_save: §b• Void Refund §7- If an Ability Item falls into the void, the global server counter is automatically refunded so it can be crafted again.
command.abilityeffects.help.cmd_craftabl: §b• /ability craftable §7- Opens a GUI displaying global item limits and remaining crafts.
command.abilityeffects.help.cmd_drop: §b• /ability drop <ability> §7- Safely deactivates an active ability and returns it as an item.
command.abilityeffects.help.cmd_help: §b• /ability help §7- Shows this comprehensive technical documentation.
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.spee:
§7- §ePassive: §7+50% Movement Speed boost.
   §7- §aActive: §7Launches you forward based on looking direction with custom sound.
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.fire:
§7- §ePassive: §7Complete immunity to all fire and lava damage.
   §7- §aActive: §7Triggers a massive 5.0-force explosion (no damage to self) and evaporates all nearby water in a 10-block radius.
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.heal:
§7- §ePassive: §7Gives you +25% permanent Maximum Health slots.
   §7- §aActive: §7Instantly heals 4 full hearts (8.0 HP).
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.feat:
§7- §ePassive: §7Completely negates all fall damage.
   §7- §aActive: §7Launches you high up into the air with a wind charge burst.
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.stre:
§7- §ePassive: §7Adds +3.0 Base Attack Damage dynamically.
   §7- §aActive: §7Grants temporary Strength II effect for 10 seconds.
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.mini:
§7- §ePassive: §7+30% Mining Efficiency boost.
   §7- §aActive: §7Activates Instant-Break for 10 seconds (does not apply to Obsidian/Bedrock).
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.ward:
§7- §ePassive: §7Silences your footsteps completely; cancels all block vibrations and sculk impulses.
   §7- §aActive: §7Fires a devastating Sonic Boom ray up to 20 blocks, dealing 13.0 damage and knockback.
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.with:
§7- §ePassive: §7Attacking targets has a 10% chance to inflict Wither for 20 seconds.
   §7- §aActive: §7Shoots a horizontal spread of 4 dangerous Wither Skulls simultaneously.
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.pull:
§7- §ePassive: §7Attacking players has a 10% chance to pull them towards you.
   §7- §aActive: §7Continuously pulls all nearby players within a massive 50-block area towards your exact location for 15 seconds.
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.trac:
§7- §ePassive: §7Attacking a player automatically applies the Glowing effect for 60 seconds.
   §7- §aActive: §7Opens a GUI to select an online player, showing coordinates and rendering a dynamic red laser beam pointing directly to them.
command.abilityeffects.help.ability.ende:
§7- §ePassive: §7Drinking Dragon's Breath grants massive dynamic buffs (Regen, Resistance, Fire Res, Absorption) and returns the glass bottle.
   §7- §aActive: §7Summons a rideable Ender Dragon controlled by your view direction for 10 seconds.
command.abilityeffects.help.recipes: §b• Recipes §7- All crafting recipes can be found on our Discord server.
command.abilityeffects.help.discord: §b• Discord §7- Use §a/discord§7 to get the invite link.
command.abilityeffects.help.rules: §b• Rules §7- Use §a/rules§7 to read the official server guidelines.
